office: Secretary of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, Elections Division
page: https://www.sec.state.ma.us/divisions/elections/voting-information/announcing-certifying.htm (the office's 'Where Do I Find Election Results?' page; certified results later appear at https://electionstats.state.ma.us/)

feeds.what: the office's statement that it publishes no unofficial results

headers_needed.note: www.sec.state.ma.us answers curl with an Imperva (Incapsula) JavaScript challenge; this copy is the DOM saved from headless Chrome

feeds.notes: Verbatim: 'Unofficial results are announced by poll workers shortly after polls close on Election Night. These results are typically shared with media organizations and may be posted online by local election officials. ... We do not publish unofficial election results.' and 'local officials don't report unofficial results to the state. We receive election results from cities and towns only after local clerks finalize and certify them.' Local officials have 15 days after a state election to submit official results; final certification by the Governor and Governor's Council 'typically occurs in late November or early December'.

feeds.what: the certified-results archive (PD43+), search for 2026: lists the September primaries and 2026 special elections, no November 3 general yet
feeds.notes: 512 contests listed for 2026: 253 'Democratic Primary', 253 'Republican Primary', and six special-election rows. No row with stage 'General Election' as of 2026-11-10. Each contest has an id (tr id="election-id-172905" = 2026 U.S. Senate Democratic primary) and a page /elections/view/<id>. This is where the certified November results will be published, weeks after the election; it is an archive, not a count in progress.

election_id: none (no live feed).
